test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven people B, C, D, I, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. I sits fourth to the right of J. Only two people sit between B and C when counted from the left of B. D sits third to the left of K. L is an immediate neighbour of K and C. How many people between I and L when counted from the left of L?
solution:
Given: Seven people B, C, D, I, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

I sits fourth to the right of J.

D sits third to the left of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/781b356b5073e073767e15a549fee2d808647fe7ff26d2bf4a9ea1367bf659d6.png] 

Only two people sit between B and C when counted from the left of B.

L is an immediate neighbour of K and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9520b380a9d0fc7e86d00ba5adcf64fb7d121ad3f8231af924f7eff558c58f4.png] 

Here,There are **Four** people between I and L when counted from the left of L.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
